title: interplains/Zero-Breach-Toolkit
why_read: A free, offline toolkit for detecting traces of known commercial spyware (like Pegasus-style tools) across major desktop and mobile platforms, relevant to security-conscious engineers and journalists.
analysis: Mercenary spyware, sold commercially to governments and used to target journalists, activists, and dissidents, is a serious and growing threat, and open tools to detect infection are genuinely valuable. Running entirely offline is an important design choice since it avoids leaking data to a third-party server and reduces the risk of tipping off attackers monitoring network traffic. Supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iPhone backups gives it broad practical coverage for a privacy and security audience. This looks like a legitimate defensive security tool rather than an offensive one, making it a worthwhile highlight.
